eps.ov: Kabamaru, a ninja boy from the mountain village of Iga, arrives in Tokyo and turns heads with his earnest yet hilarious ways.
eps.oa: يصل «كابامارو»، الفتى النينجا من قرية «إيغا» الجبلية، إلى طوكيو فيلفت الأنظار بطباعه الصادقة المضحكة في آن.

eps.ov: Kabamaru unexpectedly finds himself the most popular kid at his new school, Kingyoku Academy.
eps.oa: يجد «كابامارو» نفسه على غير توقع أشهر فتى في مدرسته الجديدة، «أكاديمية كينغيوكو».

eps.t: Give It Your All! Yakisoba D
eps.ov: Bursting with energy and his bottomless love of yakisoba, Kabamaru throws himself into a new challenge with everything he's got.
eps.ta: ابذل كل ما عندك! ياكيسوبا D
eps.oa: يندفع «كابامارو»، بطاقته المتفجرة وحبه الذي لا قاع له للياكيسوبا، إلى تحدٍّ جديد بكل ما أوتي.

eps.ov: Tender feelings start to bloom between Kabamaru and Mai amid an awkward, comical mix-up.
eps.oa: تبدأ مشاعر رقيقة تتفتح بين «كابامارو» و«ماي» وسط سوء فهم محرج مضحك.

eps.ov: An unexpected discovery leads Kabamaru into a fresh confrontation and adventure.
eps.oa: يقود اكتشاف غير متوقع «كابامارو» إلى مواجهة ومغامرة جديدتين.

eps.t: Troubled Minds and the Transformation Game
eps.ov: Kabamaru's worries spiral into a playful game of disguises and transformations.
eps.oa: تتصاعد هموم «كابامارو» حتى تصير لعبة مرحة من التنكر والتحول.

eps.t: The Loneliness of the Yakisoba Runner
eps.ov: Between endless running and his love of yakisoba, Kabamaru tastes the loneliness of the long-distance runner.
eps.oa: بين الركض الذي لا ينتهي وحبه للياكيسوبا، يذوق «كابامارو» وحدة عدّاء المسافات الطويلة.

eps.t: Side Story! The Two from the Ninja Village
eps.ov: A side story returns to the ninja village of Iga, reuniting Kabamaru with his comrade Hayate.
eps.ta: قصة جانبية! الاثنان من قرية النينجا
eps.oa: تعود قصة جانبية إلى قرية النينجا «إيغا»، فيلتقي «كابامارو» رفيقه «هاياتي» من جديد.

eps.ov: Kaoru the kunoichi shows up to dazzle everyone with her skills and charm.
eps.oa: تظهر فتاة النينجا «كاورو» فتبهر الجميع بمهاراتها وجاذبيتها.

eps.t: Jigsaw Love on a Holy Night
eps.ov: On a holy night, the threads of love tangle like a scattered jigsaw waiting to be pieced together.
A closely guarded ninja secret — an elixir that brings the dead back to life — sets off a string of bizarre situations.
Pranks and surprises pile up when someone takes on the role of a stern guardman.
A comic bedroom mix-up turns the whole night upside down.
A romantic encounter under the starlight brings two hearts unexpectedly closer.
Grueling athletic training and contests take the gang back to their roots in Iga.

eps.t: Brotherhood Code of the Ninja Village
eps.ov: In the ninja village of Iga, the bond of brotherhood between Kabamaru and Hayate is put to the test.
Kabamaru is gripped by confused feelings for Mai and can't figure out how to confess.
A storm blows in along with a loud newcomer who turns everything upside down.
Mai plays detective in a mysterious yet comical case.

eps.t: Secret! The First Loves of Ran & Su
eps.ov: A charming secret comes to light about the first loves of Madam Ran and Madam Su.

eps.t: Secret Technique! The Yakisoba Baseball Mystery
eps.ov: A secret ninja technique and a strange mystery wrap around a baseball game with a yakisoba flavor.
Mai is kidnapped in the middle of a raging storm, and Kabamaru races to the rescue.

eps.t: Showdown in the Night Fog! A Man's Resolve
eps.ov: In the night fog, a decisive showdown unfolds as the men settle their scores with honor.

eps.t: What You Might Call a Goodbye Day
eps.ov: The hour of farewell arrives, bringing Kabamaru's adventure to a moving close.
